text: Condense the five-subsystem architecture (execution engine, expert scheduler, memory manager, streaming engine, telemetry/controller) into responsibilities, interfaces, and what each must NOT touch. Include the frozen v1 data path: exact router to residency to deadline queue to NVMe to staging to fused kernels to retain/discard, plus L+1 post-mix to lower-priority staging-only queue. Flag missing cancellation/backpressure paths. 700+ words.
